Jordan Lee: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. dropping concise notes + owners. react to claim or correct.

Ava Chen: small timing update: Dedicated GA is 'late Q2' for now — will lock exact date by next Wed. :calendar:

Miguel Torres: pricing: provisional reserved-tier numbers are in the deck spreadsheet. i'll paste a short summary into the pricing doc next week and add a short FAQ.

Priya Patel: private/VPC onboarding: pilot installs possible mid-June before full private control-plane GA. estimate ~2 engs per customer wave. drafting checklist.

Samir (ops-bot): runbook created by @Priya - https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-onboard

Jordan Lee: ACTIONS captured: Miguel - publish provisional Dedicated pricing + FAQ (owner: @Miguel). Priya & SRE - produce first 3 onboarding checklists with per-customer eng-hour estimates (owner: @Priya). Ava - confirm GA date by next Wed and update comms (owner: @Ava). Jordan - schedule 30-min post-GA office hours + draft partner FAQ (owner: @Jordan).

Rashid Khan: sales needs a 1-paragraph failure-modes blurb (routing + model fallback + expected latency delta).

Miguel Torres: i'll draft a 3-sentence blurb and post to #sales by EOD.

Leah Martinez: legal: onboarding checklist must include explicit data-residency checkbox, KMS/HSM config, and audit-log export confirmation.

Priya Patel: ack, adding those items.

Elliot Park: can someone repost roadmap slide link?

Jordan Lee: deck: https://redwood.internal/slides/allhands-may2026

Ava Chen: leadership ask: propose a 3-customer beta for Private to capture infra patterns. @Priya @Miguel please nominate candidates.

Priya Patel: starting a nomination thread, ETA Mon.

Ben Wu: happy to backup office hours if Miguel is on calls.

Jordan Lee: will assume :thumbsup: confirms ownership. i'll update this thread with any changes and link the public follow-up doc.

Samir (ops-bot): reminders set for owners in 72 hours.
